name: momentum-crypto-sizing-v1
description: Inverse-vol slot sizing (volTarget) for the TSM crypto sleeve, pre-registered 2026-09-02 BEFORE any run, owner-approved from the external-stacks research (riskfolio/TSM literature: scale notional by sigma^-1). Weakness attacked: since the 2026-08-28 vol-stop override the stop DISTANCE is vol-scaled but the slot NOTIONAL is fixed (equity x 0.375), so dollar-risk-per-trade = notional x stopPct GROWS with symbol vol — DOGE systematically carries more $ risk per slot than BTC. Hypothesis: normalizing risk-$ (volTargetScale = clamp((annualizedPct/100)/realizedVol, minScale, maxScale) on the notional, the engine's own long-wired formula) improves risk-adjusted return AND compresses the DD tail (the axis the sleeve keeps failing). Declared case AGAINST: the sleeve's OOS return is concentrated in exactly the high-vol trends volTarget would downsize; the clamp caps quiet-asset upsizing at maxScale so net gross usually FALLS — return may fall with it and the excess-vs-BTC gate (+263pp at incumbent) has room but the DD gates bind at 49.2/59.4/63.6 vs 45/55/55. EVERYTHING except the volTarget axis is FROZEN to experiments/momentum-crypto-v1.json: same 8-symbol universe, window 2021-01-01..2026-07-15 asOf-pinned, 3x3 purged folds, same costs, real settled funding, BTC B&H benchmark, same acceptance gates. Declared scope cut: lookbackBars fixed at 720 (30d of 1h bars, the trail/sharpe-gate convention); a lookback sweep is a future manifest only if this axis survives. 3 candidates declared up front, none trimmed after results: incumbent-fixed (no volTarget — execution-identity rerun, adds 0 new hypotheses), vt-50 {annualizedPct 50, clamp 0.5..1.5}, vt-35 {annualizedPct 35, clamp 0.33..1.5}. priorUniqueTrials=259: 257 declared by momentum-crypto-shorts-v1 plus its 2 long/short variants. The 2 volTarget variants here are new hypotheses. Inventory incomplete, so complete=false and approval stays blocked by protocol regardless of gates.
